summarize_STO_6G_COEFFS: summarize the STO_6G_COEFFS dictionary containing zeta and c coefficients for Slater-type orbitals reverse-fit from STO-6G basis sets for 22 elements
review_STO_6G_COEFFS: review the STO_6G_COEFFS data structure mapping element symbols to orbital labels with zeta and c coefficient tuples
test_STO_6G_COEFFS: test that STO_6G_COEFFS contains expected elements like H, C, N, O and their orbital coefficient tuples
refactor_STO_6G_COEFFS: refactor the STO_6G_COEFFS dictionary to add missing elements or validate coefficient values against reference data
build_STO_6G_COEFFS: build a lookup utility that retrieves zeta and c coefficients for a given element and orbital from STO_6G_COEFFS
